name: Gateway Station
demographics: Gateway Station serves the growing Burleson community in the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area, attracting middle to upper-middle income households with a median household income of $84,264 within one mile and $88,950 within three miles. The trade area encompasses approximately 72,000 residents within three miles, with an average household income of $103,256, indicating a financially stable customer base. The center draws families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban neighborhoods, with a daytime population of nearly 60,000 within three miles, reflecting strong employment in the area.
description: Gateway Station is a premier Class A retail destination strategically positioned along I-35W in Burleson, Texas, offering exceptional visibility and accessibility to the thriving Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. Spanning over 367,000 square feet of retail space, this modern shopping center serves as a vital commercial hub for the rapidly growing Burleson community and surrounding suburbs. The center benefits from its prime location with high-traffic frontage on Interstate 35W, one of the region's major transportation corridors, ensuring maximum exposure to both local residents and interstate travelers. With ample parking featuring a ratio of 5.55 spaces per 1,000 square feet, Gateway Station provides a convenient and comfortable shopping experience for visitors. The property is professionally managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, ensuring top-tier property management and tenant services.
summary: Gateway Station is a 367,552 square foot Class A retail center prominently located on I-35W in Burleson, Texas, serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. This modern shopping destination offers high visibility and convenient access with excellent parking, managed by industry leader Kimco Realty Corporation.
